variants.title: HPGe resolution with Co-60
variants.sample: Co-60 sealed source, 37 kBq, on a coaxial HPGe detector
variants.method: Gaussian fit of the 1173 keV line
variants.unknown: the FWHM of the 1173 keV line
variants.note: The two Co-60 lines are 159 keV apart: with 1.7 keV wide peaks they stand completely separate.

variants.title: HPGe spectrum of a soil sample
variants.sample: Soil sample, 1 kg, in a Marinelli beaker 5 cm from the crystal (world-average activity)
variants.unknown: the energy of the strongest line, and so the nuclide
variants.note: World-average soil: K-40 400, uranium series 35, thorium series 30 Bq/kg. The lines identify the nuclides.

source.title: UNSCEAR 2000 Report, Annex B: world-average soil activity concentrations; NNDC / ENSDF line energies
